article.title: A brief history of Israeli ceasefire violations, from 1948 until today
article.author: Jared Hillel
article.content: Ahead of the one-year anniversary of the so-called ceasefire in Gaza, we look at a brief timeline of a long-established Israeli practice of sabotaging negotiations and violating ceasefire agreements to advance their goals.
